proof_groups.proof_strategy: Handle the six CircularAreaIsFull witnesses in manual order. Unfold store_circular_area to expose the representation and instantiate its six hidden witnesses for the entry entailment; fold it back after returns. For result 0 with distinct indices, use circular_area_distinct_indices_imply_nonfull__is_full_contract and unfold CircularAreaFullResult. For equal indices, destruct the status and the two equal-index iff clauses of CircularAreaLogicalState to prove the empty/status-zero and full/status-nonzero results. Null and string-offset goals close after unfolding their result definitions or integer normalization. Spatial postconditions reuse exactly the descriptor fields, GlobalStrings, and UCharArray.mixed_full resources from P.

per_witness_plan.proof_of_CircularAreaIsFull_entail_wit_1: select one proposition disjunct; unfold store_circular_area; instantiate operations/readidx/writeidx/b_status/physical/data_buffer; rewrite circular_area_pre=area_addr and cancel the unchanged resource
per_witness_plan.proof_of_CircularAreaIsFull_return_wit_1: select one proposition disjunct; obtain Zlength contents < capacity from distinct indices using the existing helper; unfold CircularAreaFullResult; reconstruct store_circular_area
per_witness_plan.proof_of_CircularAreaIsFull_return_wit_2: select one proposition disjunct; equal indices plus b_status=0 and the invariant's empty iff give length=0; capacity positivity makes length distinct from capacity; result is 0; fold the resource
per_witness_plan.proof_of_CircularAreaIsFull_return_wit_3: select one proposition disjunct; invariant status range turns b_status<>0 into b_status=1; equal-index/full iff gives length=capacity; result is 1; fold the resource
per_witness_plan.proof_of_CircularAreaIsFull_return_wit_4: select the GlobalStrings branch or emp branch; unfold CircularAreaErrorResult and close circular_area=0 and result=1 by hypotheses/reflexivity
per_witness_plan.proof_of_CircularAreaIsFull_partial_solv: select one proposition disjunct and normalize 0*sizeof(CHAR); the demanded literal-address equality is reflexive

proof_groups.grouping_reason: These six witnesses belong to the same loop-free helper function and share one representation-open/fold pattern plus one CircularAreaLogicalState result family. Keeping them together preserves that context, while splitting from the seven data-length witnesses is required because all 13 targets cannot form one group under max_witnesses_per_group=12.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove the non-full arithmetic, call-result branch opening, and final returns as one family. Derive capacity positivity and read/write bounds by unfolding CircularAreaLogicalState. Unfold CircularAreaFullResult to convert nonzero retval to full length and zero retval to non-full length, then unfold store_circular_area and reuse its existential layout witnesses. For the non-full return, unfold unsigned_last_nbits and CircularAreaDataLengthResult and apply the existing circular_area_unsigned_nonfull_mod_length__data_length_query lemma; for the full return rewrite the supplied length=capacity. Fold the unchanged descriptor resources back into store_circular_area. The null return is definitional.

per_witness_plan.proof_of_CircularAreaGetDataLength_safet: unfold CircularAreaLogicalState in the pure hypothesis and derive capacity>0, hence capacity<>0
use 0<=readidx,writeidx<capacity and capacity<=256 from the invariant to bound writeidx-readidx between -255 and 255, hence within INT_MIN/INT_MAX
per_witness_plan.proof_of_CircularAreaGetDataLength_entai: from CircularAreaFullResult and retval<>0 force the eq_dec full branch, obtaining length=capacity; open store_circular_area and instantiate the asserted representation
from CircularAreaFullResult and retval=0 exclude length=capacity; combine with invariant length<=capacity to get length<capacity; open store_circular_area and instantiate the representation
per_witness_plan.proof_of_CircularAreaGetDataLength_retur: unfold unsigned_last_nbits and CircularAreaDataLengthResult; apply circular_area_unsigned_nonfull_mod_length__data_length_query using CircularAreaLogicalState and the explicit non-full bound; fold store_circular_area
unfold CircularAreaDataLengthResult and rewrite the explicit length=capacity equality; fold the unchanged resource
select either generated proposition branch; unfold CircularAreaErrorResult and preserve GlobalStrings or emp
